name: skillflux
description: Manual SkillFlux harness for Codex. It only runs after an explicit SkillFlux invocation and then forwards structured signals to the SkillFlux gateway.

interface.longDescription: Runs only when SkillFlux is explicitly invoked through a slash command or platform command. Ordinary Codex requests are left untouched; no SkillFlux metadata, headers, local checks, or skill routing are applied unless the request carries an explicit invocation marker.
defaultPrompt: /skillflux Run the manual SkillFlux harness for this request.
